text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend two public members and one Chair for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board of Management. The Chair can be selected from one of the current public members appointed to the board or from one of the public member candidates being recommended for appointment. This report also provides the Civic Appointments Committee with the names of the stakeholder representatives nominated for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board of Management by the Downtown Yonge Business Improvement Association.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Vagram Movsesyan to the Sankofa Square Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on July 31, 2030 and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council appoint Samantha Summers as the Chair of the Sankofa Square Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on February 7, 2028, and until a successor is appointed. 3. City Council appoint Carrie Ashfield and Chris Hodgson as the members nominated by the Downtown Yonge Business Improvement Area for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed. 4.
